'''Kumu''' is an Exile Leader that can be found in [[Gubei Pass]], [[Central Plains]]. He's one of the exiles who is not hostile to the player.

Huanglong, (-898,294,97)

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Talk to Kumu)
:'''Kumu:''' [[Shengying]]'s not here again... Well, he's getting the hang of this!
:{{DIcon}} What makes you say that?
:'''Kumu:''' I mean he's grown up like a real fighter.
:'''Kumu:''' I asked him to compete with the folks from [[Lollo Logistics]] before but I don't feel his determination in doing this.
:'''Kumu:''' But he's into this now, always running around outside the camp.
:'''Kumu:''' Well, he must have mastered his way. Got those couriers all tamed.
:'''Kumu:''' But he didn't bring any supplies back with him...
{{Dialogue End}}
